title: Download scoped dynamic sales-order report as PDF
description: User scene: download the selected, authorized dynamic sales-order report page as a paginated PDF with Chinese headings and values. Reuse ERP-112 scoped preview and ERP-114 currency-separated page subtotals; recheck current ERP menu and salesperson scope on every export. Implement with pinned MIT PDFsharp 6.2.4 in the Infrastructure project and the available Windows SimHei font; if the required font is unavailable, return an explicit failure rather than a corrupt or glyph-missing PDF. Existing HTTP operation audit records the read-only download. Development only: no migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, irreversible operation, secret/.env change, or deployment. Run focused PDF tests plus safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: PDF endpoint reuses the authorized bounded preview request and selected column order, rejects invalid filters and access, and never queries outside the current salesperson scope.
PDFsharp 6.2.4 renders paginated selected rows and optional currency-separated page subtotals with Chinese text; missing font fails explicitly and no cross-currency total is invented.

Designer offers PDF download and visible failure handling; unit tests inspect PDF signature, page bound, selected fields, Chinese text/font failure and permission denial; document the Windows font prerequisite.
